_comment: VERIFY every offer at covers.com or each book's CO promo page before betting. Offers rotate monthly. verified date reflects last check.

books.name: BetMGM
books.terms: Bonus bets returned only if first bet loses. Full $1,500 version available in CO/AZ/OH/NC; reduced to ~$150 in PA/NJ/MI/WV/NV/NY.
books.notes: Bet the underdog. Slowest to credit bonus (up to 72h).

books.name: Fanatics
books.offer: 10 x $100/day bet match in FanCash (10 consecutive days)
books.terms: Requires 10 consecutive days of in-state betting. FanCash usable on bets or merch.
books.notes: Multi-day — only viable on an extended stay. Skip on test run.

books.name: bet365
books.terms: Seen as low as $150 in some states/periods. VERIFY.
books.notes: Low-risk qualifier, no hedge needed at $10 stake.

books.name: Caesars
books.offer: Bet $1 → 10 x 100% profit boost tokens ($25 max/boost)
books.notes: Use boosts on near-even games. Convert on trip 2 if needed.

books.name: Hard Rock Bet
books.offer: Double winnings on first 10 bets ($50 max each)

books.name: DraftKings
books.terms: Credits instantly — the one same-day conversion possible on a day trip.
books.notes: Best proof-of-loop book for a test run.

books.name: BetRivers
books.notes: Bet underdog. Good test-run book at moderate float.

books.name: Circa Sports
books.terms: CO allows online signup (unlike NV). Verify current offer.
books.notes: CO regional — bonus beyond the majors.

books.name: Betfred
books.terms: Verify current offer and CO availability.
